mapper.sql: id, biz_field_id, biz_domain_id, biz_field_type_id, create_time, update_time, workspace_id
mapper.select:
select * from sr_biz_field_domain bfd inner join sr_biz_field_type bft on bfd.biz_field_type_id = bft.id and bfd.workspace_id = bft.workspace_id inner join sr_biz_field bf on bfd.biz_field_id = bf.id and bfd.workspace_id = bf.workspace_id left join sr_biz_domain bd on bfd.biz_domain_id = bd.id and bfd.workspace_id = bd.workspace_id where bfd.workspace_id = #{p.workspaceId} and bfd.biz_domain_id != -1
and bfd.biz_field_id = #{p.bizFieldId}
